# Cargo sparse registry

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/cargo.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Cargo/Rust 1.99.1**. Registered classes: **local, remote, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/cargo/${AW_REPO}/index/`

## Before connecting

- An existing crate with Cargo.toml and source files; an existing consumer naming its dependency with registry = "weave".

Authentication: Use AW_USER and a short-lived AW_TOKEN whose subject is AW_USER. The server accepts an access/reference token as the Basic password and rechecks the subject and repository permissions. Reading requires read permission; publication requires write permission and replacement may require delete permission.

Fresh client state: Run in a disposable client container with a new /work mount, or a new temporary project directory with all the client home/cache paths below. The acceptance harness uses a new scenario directory and container. Never reuse your normal client home for this check.

## Configure

The sparse+ prefix and trailing slash are required. Cargo sends the configured token as the complete Authorization header.

```sh
export CARGO_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"
umask 077
cat > "$CARGO_HOME/config.toml" <<EOF
[registry]
global-credential-providers = ["cargo:token"]
[registries.weave]
index = "sparse+${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/cargo/${AW_REPO}/index/"
EOF
export CARGO_REGISTRIES_WEAVE_TOKEN="Basic $(printf '%s:%s' "$AW_USER" "$AW_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Publish only to the classes listed here. A federated recipe proves one-node behavior; remote repositories are read-only client sources.

Use your producer crate path. Acceptance uses a controlled crate with no build dependencies; remove --no-verify for release verification.

```sh
cargo publish --manifest-path producer/Cargo.toml --registry weave --allow-dirty --no-verify
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote, federated**. Use the selected repository key. Virtual resolution requires readable configured members; remote resolution requires an administrator-configured upstream.

For example: hello_cargo = { version = "1.0.0", registry = "weave" } in the consumer dependencies.

```sh
cargo build --manifest-path consumer/Cargo.toml
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Virtual repositories are not registered for Cargo. No command is offered for V.
- For a clean replay, use a new CARGO_HOME and recreate only the configuration above; do not copy the registry/git caches.
